title: PILLAGERS, AND EVERY MACHINE BY NAME
why: his HUD orders of 10-28: pillagers are always called pillagers, never pillager bots (the kind words, contracts, goals, events, settings, the Undercroft lines); a line never says machine without naming it: the alarm line names the machine nearest the sound (sentry alert, listener alert, overseer alert) and says nothing when no machine raised it, locked on names the machine that has you (2 sentries have you in sight), the convoy is the crawler convoy, the settings rows name the kinds
now: pillagers, never pillager bots; alerts and locked on name the machine
